locked_rules.pullback: within prior 5 completed sessions at least one low <= EMA20 and closes remain above EMA50
locked_rules.trigger: signal close > EMA20, > prior close, CLV>=0.60
locked_rules.entry: buy stop at signal-day high, valid 3 sessions

limitations: Current 53-symbol universe is projected backward, so survivorship/post-selection bias remains.
